audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Yorick levels 2, 3 and the first-item window and called 4-5 and 6 even. The audited mirror sets the lane as Yorick / Sett / Sett / Sett / Sett / Sett / Yorick.
audit.why: 48.64% over 2103 games says the lane is losing until you scale, and the packet chart agrees with the mirror. Six rows disagreed across the two sides.
audit.corrected: All six rows flipped in matched full/content pairs with ratings inverse to the mirror; whys and phase reasons rewritten so they argue for the side they now sit on.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike said his 'R suppression' without a cooldown, and gave no number for Haymaker or Facebreaker.
audit.why: The Show Stopper is 120/100/80s at 400 range; Haymaker 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s; Facebreaker 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s at 490. Eulogy of the Isles is 160/130/100s, so his six comes back twice for every one of yours at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns written into the phases and the spikes; six belongs to Sett.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions were absent and one was misdescribed. Facebreaker was written as a flat 'E grab' stun. Haymaker was called a 'true-damage burst' with no consequence drawn.
audit.why: Riot's Facebreaker text: he pulls in enemies on opposite sides of him and stuns them; if enemies are only on one side, they are slowed instead. Your own Mist Walkers standing behind him are what turns your slow into a stun — the swarm arms his stun. Haymaker's centre is true damage, so armour and Plated Steelcaps do nothing against the part that hurts; you step off the centre line rather than tank it.
audit.corrected: Facebreaker stuns only when targets are on both sides of him — keep the pack on your side of him and you are only slowed. Haymaker's centre is true damage; resistances are the wrong answer, position is.

audit.why: The missing-interactions file lists 'Sett can deny your mobility (Mourning Mist) with The Show Stopper' — that entry depends on Mourning Mist's derived dash flag, and Riot's text describes a thrown globule that grants move speed to summoned units, not a dash on Yorick. Nothing to ground. Not written to the page.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Haymaker's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Haymaker's centre is true damage — armour does not reduce it, so give ground while his Grit bar is full instead of tanking it.

edits.after: Mourning Mist reaches 700 and marks him for your pack — level 1 is yours.

edits.before: Raise 3-4 ghouls, E-mark Sett so they leap, W-cage the retreat, and AA alongside the swarm — the ghouls out-damage you both.
edits.after: Raise 3-4 Mist Walkers, Mourning Mist him so they sprint in, Dark Procession his retreat, and AA alongside the swarm.

edits.before: - Sett Haymaker: matchup-defining — His shield + true-damage burst. Swarm after it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

notes: The Facebreaker finding is the one that changes play: Yorick is the champion in the game most likely to arm Sett's stun on himself, because Mist Walkers chase the Mourning Mist mark and end up behind Sett. Nothing on the page said so. The chart flip is large but it is exactly the mirror's chart, and every side edit is paired full+content with the inverse rating.
